title: OPDS Reader for iPhone & Android | Sutra
description: Browse supported OPDS catalogs with Sutra on iPhone or Android. See supported formats, setup steps, free and Pro limits, and sync boundaries.
h1: Read your OPDS library on iPhone and Android
intro: Sutra connects to supported OPDS catalogs on iOS and Android so you can browse and open compatible DRM-free books. OPDS provides catalog access; it does not by itself guarantee reading-progress synchronization or support for every server and feed.
benefits: Add a catalog using its OPDS feed or server address and credentials when required.
Browse compatible EPUB, PDF, CBZ, and MOBI books; the file's format determines its Sutra tier.
Download supported books to read offline after acquisition.
steps: Get the OPDS feed or server address from the catalog provider or administrator.
In Sutra, choose Add Library and enter the address. Supply credentials if the catalog requires them.
Browse the catalog and open a compatible book. Follow any download or acquisition action shown by the catalog.
Download a supported file for offline reading when you need access without a network connection.
limitations: OPDS implementations vary. Feed versions, authentication methods, file links, and server features may differ.
Generic OPDS access does not imply server-specific sync or streaming. Kavita and Komga have separate integration behavior.
Full CBZ and DRM-free MOBI require Pro; CBR and DRM-protected files are not supported.

faq.q: What OPDS URL should I enter?
faq.a: Use the OPDS feed address supplied by the server or catalog administrator. Some servers require a server-specific endpoint and credentials.

faq.q: Does Sutra support every OPDS server?
faq.a: OPDS servers vary in feed format, authentication, and acquisition links. Compatibility depends on what the server exposes; consult its documentation and test the feed.

faq.q: Does generic OPDS sync my reading progress?
faq.a: Generic OPDS catalog access does not guarantee reading-progress synchronization. Sutra's server-specific sync integrations are separate from generic OPDS.

faq.q: Which formats can I read from OPDS?
faq.a: Sutra supports EPUB, PDF, CBZ, and DRM-free MOBI files where the catalog exposes compatible file links. EPUB and PDF are free; full CBZ and DRM-free MOBI require Pro.

faq.q: Can I read OPDS books offline?
faq.a: A compatible book can be read offline after it has been downloaded or acquired to the device.
